race.command_help: Racing: /shahed race list | join <name> | cancel | preview <name> | records <name>. Use your own training drone.

Gates are centered at eye position, perpendicular to horizontal facing. Route changes reset records.
help.shahed.title: Help
help.shahed.obtain: EQUIPMENT. In Survival, craft a drone, FPV goggles and controller at a crafting table; iron unlocks the recipes. In Creative, use KRIVYE RUKI AEROSPACE. Use the drone item on an open area to deploy it; Survival consumes one item.
help.shahed.bind: CONNECTING. Use the controller on your drone to bind it. Equip goggles in the head slot, hold the controller and use it in the air to enter FPV. Sneak + use outside FPV clears binding. Your body remains in the world.
help.shahed.flight: FLIGHT. %s: thrust; %s: reduce thrust; %s / %s: bank; %s: climb assist; %s: descend; %s: brake; %s: exit. Takeoff requires a ground run. Exiting cuts thrust while preserving momentum.
help.shahed.camera: CAMERA. Mouse: heading and pitch; %s: settings; %s: FULL/MINIMAL HUD. %s / %s: yaw; %s / %s: pitch. Settings include HUD color, FOV and night vision. Rebind keys in Minecraft Controls.
help.shahed.racing: RACING. Pilot a training SHAHED or a new FPV without a module. Settings → Racing → choose course → Join. Green marks the next gate; crossing start begins the timer, the final gate finishes. Pass gates in order. Your connected aircraft selects the record category.
help.shahed.challenges: CHALLENGES. Time trial: fastest run; precision: small gates; obstacle: route around terrain chosen by an admin. UUID/type records persist on the server. Loss of control cancels the attempt. Joining again starts a new attempt.
item.shahed.quad.hint: Hover and land. Use a module on your powered-off, landed drone to attach it.
item.shahed.contact_quad.hint: Single-use. Hover and strafe; a hard collision triggers an explosion.
item.shahed.jet.hint: Single-use. Fast acceleration, inertia and banking turns; cannot hover.
item.shahed.arcade_payload.hint: One slot on the reusable FPV. Attachment consumes one module; release while piloting.
fleet.payload.attach_denied: Use your powered-off, landed reusable FPV with an empty slot and SAFE disabled.
fleet.payload.released: Module released: EMPTY. Aircraft control continues.
fleet.payload.denied: Cannot release: empty, landed, SAFE, obstructed or server limit reached.
fleet.armed: SAFE disabled. Server combat settings now apply.
fleet.arm_denied: Only the nearby owner of a stationary, powered-off, landed aircraft can disable SAFE.
help.shahed.fleet: FLEET. Quadcopters: %s / %s forward/back, %s / %s left/right, %s / %s up/down, %s brake. Neutral input hovers. Reusable FPV can land and fly again; contact FPV is single-use. Jet FPV: SHAHED controls, high speed and inertia, no hover. Controller and goggles work with every aircraft.
help.shahed.payload: MODULE. Use a module on your powered-off, landed reusable FPV: one item is consumed and LOADED is visible to everyone. %s releases in flight; EMPTY follows and flight continues. Disconnecting stops the motors. Land and power off to attach another module.
help.shahed.fleet_safety: RACING AND SAFE. Connect to the desired aircraft before choosing a course. New FPV aircraft enter without a module; SHAHED must be training. Records are separated by type. SAFE persists after finish/cancel/disconnect. To disable it explicitly: land, power off, sneak-use your aircraft with an empty hand. Training SHAHED is always safe.
